additionalDescription: Energy waste is often invisible, making it easy to ignore. Plasma was designed to make energy consumption tangible and actionable. Real-time visualizations show exactly where energy goes, while AI-powered recommendations identify savings opportunities that would otherwise go unnoticed.
highlights: Built real-time monitoring with IoT sensor integration
Implemented ML-based consumption prediction with 95% accuracy
Created automated demand response for peak load management
Designed ROI calculators for sustainability investments
